import base64,hashlib,json,os,sys
from pathlib import Path
assert sys.flags.isolated and sys.dont_write_bytecode
root=Path("/Users/zacheryspector/studio-scratch/1370-c0-f1-two-stage-route-proposal-r1")
review=Path("/Users/zacheryspector/studio-scratch/1370-c0-f1-two-stage-route-independent-review-r1/RECEIPT.json")
manifest_pin,route_pin,supervisor_pin,review_pin=sys.argv[1:5]
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert str(root) not in sys.path and not root.is_symlink()
mb=(root/"MANIFEST.json").read_bytes(); assert sha(mb)==manifest_pin
code=(root/"route.py").read_bytes(); assert sha(code)==route_pin
sb=(root/"supervisor.py").read_bytes(); assert sha(sb)==supervisor_pin
rb=base64.b64decode(os.environ["F1_ROUTE_REVIEW_B64"],validate=True); assert sha(rb)==review_pin
assert review.read_bytes()==rb
assert json.loads(rb)=={"decision":"ACCEPT","package":"1370-C0-F1-TWO-STAGE-ROUTE-R1","classification":"EXPLORATORY_NOT_ACCEPTANCE","manifestSha256":manifest_pin,"routeSha256":route_pin,"supervisorSha256":supervisor_pin}
os.environ["F1_ROUTE_EXTERNAL_MANIFEST_SHA256"]=manifest_pin
sys.argv=[str(root/"route.py"),*sys.argv[5:]]
exec(compile(code,str(root/"route.py"),"exec"),{"__name__":"__main__","__file__":str(root/"route.py"),"_EXTERNAL_EXECUTED_ROUTE_BYTES":code,"_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_REVIEW_BYTES":rb})
